steps.action: Albus can be found, disguised as a pot, at the top of the slope past the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, near the Depraved Perfumer. Roll or attack the pot to break the illusion and reveal Albus. Exhaust his dialogue to obtain the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), which can be shown to Latenna the Albinauric at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack in order to progress her questline.

*(Optional)* Alexander can first be found in Stormhill, stuck in a pothole atop a cliff southwest of the Saintsbridge Site of Grace. He will call out once you get close. After talking to him, agree to help him and then stand behind him and hit him. Once you have dealt sufficient damage, he will burst free of the hole. Exhaust his dialogue again to receive an Exhalted Flesh.

*(Optional)* Alexander can next be found near the Rear Gael Tunnel Site of Grace, accessible via the Limgrave entrance. By progressing through the dungeon from the Caelid entrance, you will be able to unlock the door blocking Alexander's path. Exhaust his dialogue to continue his questline.
*(Optional)* Alexander will be standing in the plaza as long as you have triggered the Radahn Festival. He is also available as a summon during the Starscourge Radahn boss fight.
After defeating Starscourge Radahn, Alexander can be found near the Site of Grace in the Wailing Dunes. Exhaust his dialogue to progress his questline.

(Optional) Alexander will be in a pothole on the cliffs above Jarburg, south of the Artist's Shack (Liurnia of the lakes). He will once again ask you to hit him, however doing so will not free him. You must throw an Oil Pot at him, talk to him again, and then hit him several more times to free him. Speak to him again to receive three Exalted Flesh.

Alexander can be found in a pool of lava south of Fort Laiedd, near a Magma Wyrm encounter. To speak to him without taking damage from the lava, ride Torrent to a sloped rock in front of him and dismount. Speak to him to receive the Jar helmet.
*(Optional)* Alexander can be summoned during the Fire Giant boss fight. His summon sign is just inside the arena.

Alexander will be standing on a floating platform close to the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace. He will request a duel. After defeating him, exhaust his dialogue and pick up Alexander's Innards and a Shard of Alexander. Alexander's Innards can be given to Jar-Bairn at the end of his own questline.
When approaching Stargazers' Ruins, Aureliette's voice can be heard from inside the main building.
Use the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes obtained from Roderika, Spirit Tuner in front of Aureliette.
After a brief dialogue, she will disappear, and the seal blocking access to the cellar containing the Primal Glintstone Blade will be gone.

Head north-west from the Site of Grace to find Rya the Scout inside a gazebo and talk to her. Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select **Give me the necklace** and then **Deal** to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. After purchasing the item, he'll start selling an infinite supply of Boiled Prawns. Purchase at least one to progress his questline: you'll receive the "Spread Out" gesture and, in turn, Boggart's summon sign will appear at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook to aid you against Magma Wyrm Makar.

After resting at a Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, Boggart will move to the outer moat along the northern wall of Leyndell, Royal Capital in the Capital Outskirts (due west from the Capital Rampart Site of Grace). You may now purchase an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs. Exhaust Boggart's dialogue about Dung Eater. After freeing Dung Eater from his cell in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds, Boggart will have some additional dialogue.

After hearing Boggart's final piece of dialogue about Dung Eater, warning you that Dung Eater is lurking nearby, reload the area to find Boggart bound to a chair. Speak to him to trigger an invasion from Dung Eater. Defeat Dung Eater and return to Boggart, who is now dead. Loot his equipment, as well as the Seedbed Curse.

Blaidd can be heard howling in Mistwood. After hearing the howl, speak to Merchant Kalé and select "**About the howling in Mistwood.**" This will unlock the "Finger Snap" gesture. Use Finger Snap at the Mistwood Ruins near the ruined tower adjacent to the slumbering Runebear to cause Blaidd to jump down. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue.

Enter the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in Limgrave and defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. Blaidd will be available as a summonable cooperator during this fight. After defeating Darriwil, Blaidd appears outside the Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Speak with him to earn a [[Somber Smithing Stone 2|Somber Smithing Stone [2]]].
After entering Ranni's service, a projection of Blaidd appears in Ranni's Rise and offers dialogue. This step is skipped if Starscourge Radahn has already been defeated.

Blaidd moves to the base of an enormous ruined bridge on the bank of the Siofra River, located between the  Siofra River Bank and  Worshipper's Woods Sites of Grace. He will suggest asking Preceptor Seluvis about how to reach Nokron, Eternal City. This step is skipped if Starscourge Radahn has already been defeated. (Optional) After speaking to Seluvis about Nokron and then speaking to Sorceress Sellen, return to Blaidd and exhaust his dialogue. He will move to Redmane Castle afterwards.
Blaidd will appear in the  Redmane Castle Plaza when the Radahn Festival begins. He also appears as an optional summon in the fight against Starscourge Radahn.
(Optional) After defeating Radahn, speak to Blaidd next to the  Starscourge Radahn Site of Grace. He will mark the location of the *Starfall Crater*—entrance to Nokron, Eternal City—on your map.
(Optional) Interact with the Forlorn Hound Evergaol to speak to Blaidd. Either choose to release him or leave him.
After giving Ranni the Dark Moon Ring, Blaidd will appear as a hostile NPC outside Ranni's Rise, surrounded by the bodies of slain Black Knife Assassins. Defeat him to receive his armor and weapon.
(Optional) Speak to War Counselor Iji to deliver the news of Blaidd's death.

The following two steps can be completed in either order. His dialogue will vary depending on where he is met first. Yura can be found under a fallen Azula ruin near the  Seaside Ruins site of grace, southwest of Agheel Lake. Exhaust his dialogue and his summon sign will appear in Agheel Lake to assist against Flying Dragon Agheel. Speak to him again after defeating Agheel for further dialogue. Enter the Murkwater River, the ravine north of Agheel Lake, and head towards Murkwater Cave. Bloody Finger Nerijus will invade you. After fighting Nerijus for a while, Yura appears to assist you. After defeating Nerijus, continue along the ravine to find Yura under a bridge. Exhaust his dialogue.

A red summon sign can be found northeast of the  Raya Lucaria Main Gate. Interact with it to assist Yura in defeating Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin. After defeating the foe, Yura can be found on the bridge near where the summon sign was. Speak to him to receive a [[Smithing Stone 5|Smithing Stone [5]]].

Travel to the Second Church of Marika, located northwest of the  Altus Highway Junction site of grace, where Yura lies on the ground. Speak to him, and then pick up the Nagakiba. Shortly after, Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger will invade. Defeat her to receive Eleonora's Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear.

Once you travel to the Mountaintops of the Giants, Yura's quest will be locked regardless of which steps have been completed. Shabriri will be waiting near the  Zamor Ruins site of grace, in possession of Yura's reanimated body. The Nagakiba can be found on the ground in whichever location he would have been at, depending on how far into his questline you have progressed.
Liurnia of the Lakes (Main Academy Gate)

After defeating Bloody Finger Nerijus in Limgrave and talking with Bloody Finger Hunter Yura, the invasion sign of the Ravenmount Assassin will appear within the Academy of Raya Lucaria: upon defeating him, talk to Yura on the same bridge to receive a Smithing Stone [5] x1 from Yura, progressing his questline to Altus Plateau.
Corhyn can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold, where he will offer to teach you several Incantations. His shop inventory can be increased by giving him prayerbooks.
After reaching Altus Plateau, Corhyn will express an interest in searching for Goldmask.
Corhyn can be found north of the the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace. Talking to him here after finding Goldmask will allow you to reveal Goldmask's location to him.
Corhyn will now appear next to Goldmask. The pair will now travel together.

Corhyn and Goldmask can be found near the colosseum. Corhyn will express frustration at Goldmask's current obsession with Radagon. After using Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue past the lift near Erdtree Sanctuary, talk to Goldmask to reveal Radagon's secret and then talk to Corhyn.

Corhyn and Goldmask will move to the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins. Corhyn can be offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, which will affect the end of his questline. If offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, Corhyn will remain in this location after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade after Goldmask leaves. After reloading the area, he will have disappeared, leaving behind his flail, robe, and bell bearing.

If Corhyn was not offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, he will appear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, close to the giant Bolt of Gransax after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. After exhausting his dialogue and resting at a Site of Grace, he will be gone.

Edgar can be found atop a tower in Castle Morne. Showing him Irina's Letter prompts him to tell you about the legendary sword stolen by the Misbegotten and will make him available as a summonable ally against the Leonine Misbegotten boss.
After defeating the Leonine Misbegotten, return to Edgar and exhaust his dialogue.
Edgar will be standing over Irina's body. Exhaust his dialogue. If the player killed Irina, Edgar will be hostile.
The bodies of slain Scaly Misbegotten form a trail to the Revenger's Shack. **Edgar the Revenger** invades as the player approaches the shack.

Jerren can be encountered in Redmane Castle before initiating the Radahn Festival, sitting on a chair inside the church just beyond the Redmane Castle Plaza. Speaking to him here will unlock some additional dialogue with War Counselor Iji.

When the Radahn Festival commences, Jerren can be found on a podium overlooking the plaza. Speak to him and select "Ready as I'll ever be" to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, wait for Jerren to finish speaking to receive the "Heartening Cry" Gesture. Next, go into the church behind Jerren and take the elevator down. Use the sending gate at the bottom of the elevator to reach the Wailing Dunes
Defeat Starscourge Radahn. *(Optional)* Castellan Jerren's summon sign will appear mid-fight during Radahn's second phase.
Jerren can be spoken to once more after the Radahn Festival, in the same location he was in before the festival. After exhausting his dialogue he will disappear.

After following Sellen's questline up until she gives you Sellen's Primal Glintstone, reload and return to Witchbane Ruins to find Witch-Hunter Jerren. Exhaust his dialogue to progress to the next step.

After transplanting Sellen's Primal Glintstone into the puppet in the cellar beneath Three Sisters, there will be two summon signs outside the door to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. To progress Jerren's questline, interact with the red summon sign. You will be summoned to assist Jerren in defeating Sellen. Defeat Sellen to receive the Witch's Glintstone Crown and Sellen's Bell Bearing. After the fight, speak to Jerren, who will be just outside the room. Exhaust his dialogue to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Speak with Count Ymir to receive Hole-Laden Necklace and Ruins Map
Ring the bell to receive Crimson Seed Talisman +1
Speak with Count Ymir to receive Ruins Map (2nd)
Ring the bell to receive Cerulean Seed Talisman +1
Speak with Count Ymir to receive Beloved Stardust and Ruins Map (3rd) Rest Activate Ymir’s throne and descend the ladder
Defeat Recusant Swordhand of Night Anna to receive Claws of Night Ring the bell Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers to receive Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

Activate Ymir’s throne Defeat Swordhand of Night Jolán Defeat Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers to receive Maternal Staff, High Priest Set, and Ymir's Bell Bearing. Cherishing Fingers can now be found in the graveyard by taking the western exit of Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

Devin can be found outside the Valiant Gargoyles' duo boss arena beyond Hallowhorn Grounds (north). He can be given the full Twinned Set if you obtained it at the end of D, Hunter of the Dead's questline. (Optional) He is available as a summon for the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss after being given the Twinned Set and reloading the area. If D, Beholder of Death, was given a Twinned Set that was obtained by directly killing D, Hunter of the Dead, then he will be hostile the next time the area is loaded. He will drop both the Twinned Set and the Inseparable Sword upon death, immediately ending his questline right there.

After completing Fia, Deathbed Companion's questline and obtaining the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince, D can be found standing over Fia's slain corpse. After reloading the area, he will be gone, and the Inseparable Sword and Twinned Set can be found nearby.

*(Optional)* D can first be encountered close to Saintsbridge in Limgrave. He will warn you about Summonwater Village, which is overrun by Those Who Live in Death, including a Tibia Mariner. *(Optional)* After defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village, D will appear appear in the village and offer to introduce you to Gurranq.

D will appear in Roundtable Hold regardless of whether he was encountered in Limgrave. If you have at least one Deathroot and did not complete step 1, he will offer to introduce you to Gurranq. D will begin selling Incantations after you have met Gurranq. He will also become available as a cooperator in Black Knight Catacombs as well as against the Tibia Mariner in Liurnia of the Lakes. After progressing Fia's questline, the Weathered Dagger can be given to D. After reloading the area, Fia can be found standing over D's corpse in a previously inaccessible room in Roundtable Hold.
Boc can be found in the form of a small tree near Gatefront Ruins. He will call out until you attack or roll into the tree, reversing the illusion and causing him to transform back.

Boc can be found lying on the ground beside the Site of Grace at the start of the dungeon. Defeating the Demi-Human Chief dual boss of the area will reward you with the Sewing Needle, which can be given to Boc.
*(Optional)* Boc will be next to the Site of Grace. He will offer to make alterations to your equipment free of charge.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (East Raya Lucaria Gate)
steps.action: *(Optional)* Boc can be given the Gold Sewing Needle, which allows him to alter Demigod equipment. He can be given the item in subsequent steps of his questline instead if this step is missed.
*(Optional)* Boc will ask if he can call you Lord at this point if he has already been given the Gold Sewing Needle. Agreeing will unlock the "My Lord" gesture.

If Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated, Boc will ask for a Larval Tear. Giving him a Larval Tear will move him to Raya Lucaria Grand Library. He will appear kneeling on the ground in human form, unresponsive. Upon reloading the area, he will be dead. Refusing to give him a Larval Tear will unlock the dialogue option "What do you really think?". Selecting this option will cause him to die just outside Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Instead of selecting either option, using Prattling Pate "You're Beautiful" in front of him will prevent him from dying. He will remain at East Capital Rampart for the rest of the game.
Optional: Meet at Grand Altar of Dragon Communion
Optional: Select *"Devour draconic essence"*
Optional: Give or withhold Thiollier's Concoction
Defeat Bayle the Dread
Return to Grand Altar of Dragon Communion

Head north-west from the Site of Grace to find Rya the Scout inside a gazebo and talk to her. Move to north-west again from here to find Blackguard Big Boggart at the Boilprawn Shack and talk to him: select **Give me the necklace** and then **Deal** to be able to buy Rya's Necklace from him for 1000 Runes. After purchasing the item, he'll start selling an infinite supply of Boiled Prawns. Purchase at least one to progress his questline: you'll receive the "Spread Out" gesture and, in turn, Boggart's summon sign will appear at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook to aid you against Magma Wyrm Makar.

After touching any Site of Grace in Altus Plateau, the Dung Eater will appear in the western quarter of the Roundtable Hold, past Gideon's study. Talk to him with at least one Seedbed Curse in inventory to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "**There's something you should know**" to warn you of the danger of the new arrival.

Drop down the open grate to the left exiting the room and follow the path past the Miranda Flowers to reach the Dung Eater's cell, which is guarded by a Large Fingercreeper hidden underground and some smaller ones hanging from the ceiling. Open the cell and talk to him, selecting **Leave your gaol!**.
*(Optional)* The Dung Eater can now be summoned to aid you against Mohg, the Omen.
*(Optional)* Alongside Melina, the Dung Eater can now be summoned to aid you against Morgott, the Omen King.

*(Optional)* The Dung Eater has disappeared from the Hold, leaving behind on his spot a message that reads: "**I'll defile you next. Come to the outer moat.**" *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "**About the spirits' voices**" to express her relief for the Dung Eater's departure.

Visit the moat to the south-east below the capital's ramparts to meet again with Boggart, who now sells an infinite supply of Boiled Crabs too. Talk to him and select **About the Dung Eater**. Reload the area to find Boggart moribund and, after talking to him, collect Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball, and Blackguard's Iron Mask from his cadaver. Shortly after, the Dung Eater will invade you and, once defeated, will drop his Sword of Milos.

The Dung Eater will have now returned to the Hold. Talking to him, he'll instruct you to defile his corpse with the Seedbed Curse. *(Optional)* Talking to Roderika, she'll now have a new dialogue option "**About the spirits' voices**".

(Optional) If you don't intend to follow his questline, you can select **Administer Seluvis' Potion** to turn the Dung Eater into a puppet. After his screams have ceased, you're free to kill him to collect his loot without failing the Preceptor's questline. After collecting all five Seedbed Curses, return to him and select **Use the Seedbed Curse**, then collect the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse from his body. Reloading the area, you'll be able to collect the Omen Set too.

After helping Yura defeat Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin at the Main Academy Gate of Raya Lucaria, you'll find him moribund inside the Second Church of Marika; exhausting his dialogues, he'll die leaving behind his Nagakiba (with the Ash of War: Piercing Fang). Shortly after, Eleonora will invade you: defeating her will award you with her Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear that counters Mohg, Lord of Blood's phase transitioning curse-attack.
Talk to him to receive the "What do you want?" Gesture.

After retrieving the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) from Old Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics, or the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)from Castle Sol, Ensha will invade the player. Upon death, he drops the Clinging Bone and his Royal Remains Set can then be collected from his original spot outside Gideon's room. Afterwards, Gideon will have a new dialogue option **About Ensha** and, once exhausted, **About the secret medallions**.

After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan and Rileigh the Idle under Tanith's request, talk to Recusant Bernahl in the eastern quarter of the manor to receive Letter to Bernhal, unlocking Wilhelm's invasion sign in Leyndell. Once Wilhelm and Vargram, the Raging Wolf are defeated, awarding you with the Raging Wolf Set, return to Bernhal to receive Gelmir's Fury.

Fia can be found in her room in Roundtable Hold. Initially she will be available to provide a Baldachin's Blessing. After Rogier comes to Roundtable Hold and discusses the Night of Black Knives, Fia will provide a Knifeprint Clue. The Black Knifeprint must be obtained and given to Rogier.

After triggering the Radahn Festival, Fia will ask you to return the Weathered Dagger to its rightful owner. You must give this to D, Hunter of the Dead, and reload the area. Fia can now be found in a previously locked room, standing over D's corpse. Exhaust her dialogue and she will disappear.
While being held, choose "Talk in Secret" to learn about the Cursemark of Death.

In order to access the Divine Tower of Liurnia, you need to have progressed Ranni the Witch's quest and received the Carian Inverted Statue. Use the statue on the pedestal in the first room of the Carian Study Hall and progress through the area to the Divine Tower. Retrieve the Cursemark of Death from the top of the tower.
Speak to Fia again and select "Talk in Secret" until you receive the option to hand Fia the Cursemark of Death. Exhaust her dialogue once again and reload the area to find her sleeping.
Interact with Fia's body to enter the Deathbed Dream. Defeat Lichdragon Fortissax to return to Deeproot Depths.
Loot the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from Fia's body. This will allow you to achieve the Age of Duskborn ending. Reload the area to find Fia dead, with D, Beholder of Death standing over her.
Enia can first be spoken to in Roundtable Hold, in the door west of the Table of Lost Grace, after defeating a Shardbearer. Exhaust her dialogue to unlock her two shop inventories.

steps.location: After defeating two Shardbearers, speak to Enia again to receive a Talisman Pouch.
steps.action: If you defeat Morgott, the Omen King before speaking to Enia during this step, the Talisman Pouch will be available to purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks.
After defeating Morgott, the Omen King and attempting to access the Erdtree, speak to Enia again for some additional dialogue.
After gaining access to Crumbling Farum Azula, speak to Enia again for some additional dialogue.

Enia will narrate the cutscene that plays after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. She will now be dead upon returning to Roundtable Hold, however her shop inventories can still be accessed by interacting with her corpse.

steps.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement or Church of the Crusade
steps.action: Defeat Queelign's first invasion

steps.location: Belurat, Tower Settlement or Church of the Crusade
steps.action: Defeat Queelign's second invasion

steps.location: Prayer Room of Shadow Keep's Church District
steps.action: Exhaust dialogue and give either an Iris of Grace or an Iris of Occultation

Gostoc can be found in the gatehouse to the left of the main gate. He will offer you the choice of taking the main gate or using the side entrance. Choosing "No, I'll use the main entrance" will cause the main gate to open when you approach it. This will not prevent you from taking the side entrance, however.

*(Optional)* Upon entering a dark room in the western section of the castle, Gostoc will close the door, locking you in with a Banished Knight enemy. To leave, grab the Rusty Key and return to the door to open it. If you die in this room, you can return to it and loot the item without being locked in again. *(Optional)* Gostoc will now appear in several locations around the dungeon. Speaking to him in one of these locations for the first time will reward you with a Grace Mimic. The locations are as follows: Stormveil Cliffside. He will appear on a ledge above the Site of Grace, only if you enter the castle via the wooden scaffold and head straight back. Western Wall ground floor. He will appear here after you have gone up the ladder past the door unlocked with the Rusty Key. Chapel roof. He will appear on the roof of the chapel where you meet Rogier, after visiting the roof with the Grafted Scion and returning. Rampart Tower. He will appear in the elevator tower, on a wooden platform that needs to be jumped to. While he is in any of these locations, he will take 30% of the Runes you drop if you die in the dungeon. In order to get him to stop, talk to him at any one of the first three listed locations, and then at the fourth location. Then, return to his location at the gatehouse and talk to him again. He will no longer steal any Runes. Additionally, he will become available as a merchant if you return to him after he begins stalking you.

After defeating Godrick the Grafted, Gostoc will appear in the room. After exhausting his dialogue his shop will be open once again. He will also stop stealing your Runes if you skipped the previous part.

After completing Nepheli Loux's questline, Gostoc will appear in the back of the throne room. After exhausting his dialogue, his shop will become available again, now with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone available to purchase.
Gowry can be found in his shack near the entrance to Sellia. He will request that you find an Unalloyed Gold Needle in the swamp and bring it to him in exchange for a secret about Sellia.
Travel to the Swamp of Aeonia and defeat Commander O'Neil to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
Give the Needle to Gowry. Reload the area and speak to him to obtain the repaired Needle.

Travel to the Church of the Plague and give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle. If you immediately go back to Gowry after this point you can unlock additional dialogue and unlock his shop. Alternately, if you reload the area and speak to Millicent in the church once again, the next time you visit Gowry's Shack Gowry will be absent and Millicent will be there in his place.

*(Optional)* After giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis, return to Gowry and speak to him again. He will now have Pest Threads in his shop inventory. Purchase the spell to unlock additional dialogue about Millicent and Malenia.
Once Millicent arrives in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, return to Gowry to hear additional dialogue. He will ask you help the sisters defeat Millicent.
Complete the final part of Millicent's questline, by using one of the summon signs to either aid Millicent or defeat her.

If you aided Millicent, Gowry will lament her decision to remove the Unalloyed Gold Needle. You may now permanently kill him to obtain the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing. If you killed Millicent in Elphael, Gowry will already be dead, and the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing can be looted from his corpse.
Summon him at any location to receive the "Casual Greeting" Gesture.

After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan under Tanith's request, talk to Patches the Untethered to receive Letter to Patches, unlocking Tragoth's invasion sign in Liurnia once Magma Wyrm Makar is defeated. Once the Great-Horned One is defeated, awarding you with the Bull-Goat Set, Rune Arc x1 and Furlcalling Finger Remedy x1, return to Patches twice to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick.

*(Optional)* Speak to D, Hunter of the Dead, after obtaining a Deathroot and he will advise you to visit Gurranq. This can either be done at the start of D's questline in Limgrave, or in Roundtable Hold.

Travel to the Bestial Sanctum at the north-eastern point of Caelid. The sending gate marked on your map by D if you showed him a Deathroot will lead you straight there. Speak to Gurranq. If you have at least one Deathroot, Gurranq will give you a Clawmark Seal and Beast Eye. The Beast Eye will notify you whenever you are close to another Deathroot.

Hand over each Deathroot you find to Gurranq in exchange for rewards. After you have given him four Deathroot, reload the area and Gurranq will attack you. After depleting 30% of Gurranq's health, he will be subdued- speak to him and reload the area so that he returns to his original position.
After giving him the ninth Deathroot, he will give you an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone before disappearing.

steps.location: Gurranq will reappear at the end of Crumbling Farum Azula, under the name Beast Clergyman. After reducing his health to 50% he will enter phase 2, under the name Maliketh, the Black Blade.
steps.action: Maliketh can be fought before completing Gurranq's questline. Doing so will not affect the questline, and Gurranq will remain in the Bestail Sanctum even after Maliketh has been defeated. Likewise, killing Gurranq in the Bestial Sanctum will not affect the fight against Maliketh. Maliketh will have unique dialogue if you complete Gurranq's questline before fighting him in Crumbling Farum Azula.
Gravesite Plain
Scadu Altus
Shadow Keep
Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim

Locate Storeroom Key and use it to unlock the Storeroom (optional) Speak with Hornsent Grandam Defeat Divine Beast Dancing Lion to receive Divine Beast Head Speak with Hornsent Grandam while wearing Divine Beast Head Rest Speak with Hornsent Grandam to receive Scorpion Stew (optional) Speak with Hornsent Grandam to replenish Scorpion Stew
(optional) Give Scorpion Stew to Hornsent
Defeat Messmer the Impaler
Speak with Hornsent Grandam to receive Gourmet Scorpion Stew
Find Igon by following his screams; he is on the floor near the  Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace outside the Dragon's Pit. Talk to him until you exhaust his dialogue.

After climbing the Jagged Peak and defeating the Jagged Peak Drake he starts screaming again, he is in the middle of the road that advances to the next area. Exhaust his dialogue until he gives you Igon's Furled Finger and asks you to summon him.

After Bayle the Dread appears in his arena, Igon can be summoned to fight him. His summon sign is right in front of the fog wall (on your very first fight against Bayle, the summon sign won't appear until the boss spawns).
Irina can be found sitting on a rock near the Bridge of Sacrifice. Talk to her and accept her request to receive Irina's Letter.
Find Castellan Edgar in Castle Morne and hand him Irina's Letter, before defeating the Leonine Misbegotten.

Return to Irina after delivering the letter to find her corpse. If you defeated the Leonine Misbegotten, Edgar will also be here. If you rested at a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes after receiving Irina's Letter, Irina will die even if you have not done the Castle Morne segment of the questline.

Jar-Bairn can be found sitting in front of a house north-west of the Site of Grace. Exhaust his dialogue and decide whether or not to accept his request- the decision does not affect the rest of the questline. After resting at a Site of Grace, speak to him again to exhaust his new dialogue.
If you have met Alexander, Warrior Jar, Jar-Bairn will have new dialogue after you rest at a Site of Grace again.
After reloading the area, speak to him again to receive dialogue about poachers. This dialogue becomes available after Knight Diallos has arrived at Volcano Manor.
After Knight Diallos has left Volcano Manor, return to Jarburg and speak to Jar-Bairn again.
Reload the area six times and speak to Jar-Bairn near the middle of the village. Speak to Diallos and then reload the area and speak to Jar-Bairn once more.
After defeating Alexander, Warrior Jar in Crumbling Farum Azula, return to Jarburg and give Jar-Bairn Alexander's Innards. Reload the area, and speak to Jar-Bairn again to receive his final dialogue.

After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan and Rileigh the Idle under Tanith's request, retrieve the Red Letter to unlock Juno Hoslow's invasion sign in the Mountaintops of the Giants. With Rileigh dead, you can also talk to Recusant Bernahl to receive the Letter to Bernahl, offering you to join him in his hunt against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
Once Juno is disposed of, return to Tanith to receive the Taker's Cameo: she'll now offer to transport you to the Audience Pathway Site of Grace by selecting **See the Lord**.
Speak to Kenneth atop the ruin near the Third Church of Marika and agree to clear his fort.
Kill the Godrick Knight in Fort Haight.
Return to Kenneth and receive an Erdsteel Dagger. Accept his offer to make you a knight.
Speak to Kenneth in Fort Haight.
Complete Nepheli Loux's questline.
Speak to Kenneth in Stormveil Castle, in the throne room beyond the Godrick the Grafted Site of Grace.
*(Optional)* Speaking to Bernahl unlocks the option to purchase Ashes of War from him, regardless of the answer to his question.
Speaking with Tanith and selecting "**Join Volcano Manor**" to receive the Drawing-Room Key, Bernahl will relocate to the eastern quarter of the manor, where Rya the Scout is also found.

After assassinating Old Knight Istvan, as commissioned in the first Letter from Volcano Manor, speaking to Bernahl unlocks the option to purchase the Ashes of War he used to sell in Limgrave and two new additions, Eruption and Assassin's Gambit.

After assassinating Rileigh the Idle, as commissioned in the second Letter from Volcano Manor, speaking to Bernahl prompts him to give the Letter to Bernahl to the Tarnished, inviting him to join forces against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm at the Fortified Manor of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

steps.location: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Fortified Manor, First Floor)
steps.action: Interacting with the invasion sign before the corpse holding Alberich's Set allows the Tarnished to fight alongside Bernahl against Vargram and Wilhelm. This assassination will reward the Tarnished with Vargram's Raging Wolf Set.
With the task fulfilled, returning to Bernahl prompts him to give Gelmir's Fury to the Tarnished. This will also unlock his summon sign in Crumbling Farum Azula.
After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, exhausting Bernahl's dialogue triggers his departure from Volcano Manor. His shop will still be accessible via the "Sword of Bernahl" left on his chair.

*(Optional)* If the Tarnished and Bernahl hunted down Vargram and Wilhelm in Leyndell, the recusant's summon sign will appear outside the Dragon Temple, to aid his brother in arms against the Godskin Duo.

steps.location: Crumbling Farum Azula (Besides the Great Bridge)
steps.action: Following the path to the north from the Great Bridge, Bernhal will invade the Tarnished before the tower with the chest containing the Old Lord's Talisman. When defeated, he drops the Blasphemous Claw.
(Optional) Diallos can be found in Roundtable Hold upon the player's first visit. He will ask you to look out for his servant, Lanya, who has gone missing.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Academy Gate Town)
steps.action: Diallos will appear in Liurnia of the Lakes, northwest of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue.
Diallos will return to Roundtable Hold. Speak to him to learn the location of Volcano Manor.

After joining the Recusants, Diallos will appear in the drawing room in Volcano Manor. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy or completing one of Tanith's requests, speak to Diallos again and exhaust his dialogue.

After progressing the Jar-Bairn's questline, Diallos will relocate to Jarburg in Liurnia of the Lakes. After resting at a Site of Grace five times, return to Jarburg to find Diallos dying. Speak to him and then reload the area to obtain Diallos's Mask and Hoslow's Petal Whip.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Slumbering Wolf's Shack)
steps.action: Latenna can be found at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack, accessible by clearing the Lakeside Crystal Cave. If you have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), obtained from Old Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics, she will die and you will be able to pick up Latenna the Albinauric (Spirit Ashes). If you have already obtained Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) from Castle Sol, Latenna will already be dead, and you can pick up her Spirit Ashes.
After defeating Commander Niall, continue past his arena and pick up the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left).

Travel to the Apostate Derelict in the northernmost part of the Consecrated Snowfields and approach the giant Albinauric woman to summon Latenna. Exhaust Latenna's dialogue to obtain a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Hyetta first appears near the  Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. Exhaust her dialogue, and she shall request a Shabriri Grape. Give her a Shabriri Grape, the nearest of which is south of Hyetta, found within the rear entrance to Stormveil Castle. However, the door is locked from the other side, accessible from the Stormveil Castle throne room.

Hyetta moves to a spot close to the Purified Ruins. She again asks for a Shabriri Grape, the closest of which is east of Hyetta's location, within the Purified Ruins. It is in a secret cellar, hidden beneath some wooden planks. Give her the Shabriri Grape and exhaust her dialogue.

steps.location: Gate Town Bridge (Liurnia of the Lakes)
steps.action: Hyetta will now appear just north of the  Gate Town Bridge site of grace. She will ask for yet another Shabriri Grape. The final grape is dropped by Edgar the Revenger, who ambushes the player at the Revenger's Shack, found north of the Minor Erdtree in western Liurnia. After giving her the third grape, you will have the option to tell her that the grapes are human eyes. After hearing her dialogue following this revelation, reload the area and speak to her again in the same spot.

Hyetta is next found within the ruined Bellum Church, found along the Bellum Highway. After talking to her, she will ask you to bring her a special Fingerprint Grape. This item can be obtained by defeating Festering Fingerprint Vyke, who invades the player at the Church of Inhibition in eastern Liurnia. Bring Hyetta the grape and exhaust her dialogue.

Hyetta's final location is in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, deep below Leyndell, Royal Capital, at the bottom of the Frenzied Flame Proscription. A seal at the Cathedral of the Forsaken restricts access to this location, available only after defeating Morgott, the Omen King. Exhaust her dialogue until she instructs you to unequip all Armor and interact with the burnt door at the end of the hall, past where she stands. Remove all Armor and interact with the door to initiate a cutscene wherein the player meets the Three Fingers and inherits the Flame of Frenzy. (**WARNING**: this action permanently removes Melina as a companion and sets you on the path to the "Lord of the Frenzied Flame" ending, the latter of which can only be undone by using Miquella's Needle at the storm beyond time to cheat fate.) After the cutscene, return to Hyetta and exhaust her dialogue. After speaking to her twice, the Frenzied Flame burns her away, leaving behind the Frenzied Flame Seal and five Frenzyflame Stones.
After fighting the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, Melina and Torrent appear during a cutscene. Melina grants the Flask of Crimson Tears and Flask of Cerulean Tears before departing.

After leaving the Stranded Graveyard, activate and rest at either the  Agheel Lake North or  Gatefront Ruins Sites of Grace. A cutscene will play and Melina will offer an accord. Alternatively, activate at any two Sites of Grace in the overworld and then rest at one of the following eight Sites of Grace:  Agheel Lake North, Agheel Lake South, Bridge of Sacrifice, Church of Elleh, Gatefront Ruins, Seaside Ruins, Stormhill Shack, or Third Church of Marika. *(Optional)* If you refuse her accord, you cannot enter Leyndell, Royal Capital, even with two Great Runes. You can reconsider at any time by selecting "Talk to Melina" at any Site of Grace. Accepting grants the Spectral Steed Whistle, allowing you to summon Torrent.

Melina may appear when you rest at any Site of Grace, offering the dialogue options "The Rays of Grace" and "Melina's Goal". **Note**: these options will no longer be available once you progress to the next step. Melina offers to share the words of Queen Marika when the player rests at one of the following Sites of Grace:  Church of Pilgrimage, First Church of Marika, Grand Lift of Dectus, Minor Erdtree Church, Outer Wall Battleground, Queen's Bedchamber, and Third Church of Marika. Select "Talk to Melina" and accept to hear them.

Rest at any Site of Grace outside Limgrave or fight Margit, the Fell Omen at least once to trigger another conversation in which Melina extends an invitation to the Roundtable Hold. Accepting this invite is mandatory for accessing Leyndell, Royal Capital later in the game.

After progressing Boc the Seamster's questline, Melina may appear to discuss him. If Boc moves to the  East Raya Lucaria Gate, Melina will appear there to ask about him. If Boc moves to the  Altus Highway Junction, Melina will appear there to ask about him again.

steps.location: *(Optional)* Sites of Grace (Altus Plateau or Capital Outskirts)
steps.action: Speak to Melina at any Site of Grace on the Altus Plateau or in the Capital Outskirts. This step is missed if the player enters Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Resting at a Site of Grace in Leyndell will trigger another interaction with Melina, after which she will leave you. Her dialogue options at various Sites of Grace will be temporarily unavailable. Defeat Morgott, the Omen King. *(Optional)* Melina may be summoned as a cooperator by activating her summon sign outside Morgott's boss room. Approach the entrance to the Erdtree, turn back, and rest at the  Elden Throne Site of Grace. Melina will appear and, after some dialogue, give you the Rold Medallion.

After defeating the Fire Giant and resting at the  Forge of the Giants, you may talk to Melina. Speak to her and respond "I'm Ready" to commit the cardinal sin. Melina awakens the Giants' Flame, becomes its kindling, and burns the Erdtree. The player collapses and awakens in Crumbling Farum Azula. **Note**: this ends Melina's questline, as her spirit . You will not be able to hear any dialogue you may have missed.

Visit the Frenzied Flame Proscription and interact with the Three Fingers. Melina will appear at the next Site of Grace you rest at and will leave you permanently. **Note**: this action cannot be reversed by using Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows or inserting Miquella's Needle at  Dragonlord Placidusax. You will not be able to hear any dialogue you may have missed. **Note**: you will gain the option "Listen to the flames" when resting at the  Forge of the Giants Site of Grace, allowing progression to Crumbling Farum Azula. This unlocks an additional cutscene in the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.
*(Optional)* Millicent can invade in the south-eastern part of the Swamp of Aeonia.

steps.location: Caelid (Swamp of Aeonia and Gowry's Shack)
steps.action: Defeat Commander O'Niel to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle and bring it to Gowry. Reload the area and speak to Gowry again to obtain the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle.
Give Millicent the Unalloyed Gold Needle, then rest at the Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.
Return to Gowry's Shack and exhaust Millicent's dialogue.

Find Millicent on a hill north of the  Erdtree Gazing Hill Site of Grace. Go to the Shaded Castle and find the Valkyrie's Prosthesis in a treasure chest. Return to Millicent and give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis. Millicent will now be available as a summon for the following bosses: Godskin Apostle (Windmill Heights), Draconic Tree Sentinel (Capital Outskirts), Black Blade Kindred (Forbidden Lands).
After defeating the Godskin Apostle, reload and speak to Millicent near the Site of Grace of the battle and exhaust her dialogue.
Find Millicent beside the  Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue.

Find Millicent next to the  Prayer Room Site of Grace and exhaust her dialogue. *(Optional)* Speaking to Gowry at this point will cause him to provide new dialogue explaining the next part of the questline.

After defeating the Putrid Tree Spirit there will be two summon signs on the right ledge above the Scarlet Rot pool, both very close to each other. **Selecting the gold summon sign** will send you into Millicent's world to help her fight off her four sisters: Mary, Eldest Sister; Maureen, Second Sister; Amy, Third Sister; Polyanna, Youngest Sister. Doing so will reward you with the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia. After the fight, find Millicent lying beside the poison pool and speak to her to end her quest. Afterwards, after exhausting his dialogue, Gowry will drop the Flock's Canvas Talisman if killed. Only if Millicent was assisted, Malenia will drop Miquella's Needle when revisiting the area after defeated. **Selecting the red summon sign** will send you into Millicent's world in order to kill her alongside the aforementioned NPCs. Doing so will reward you with Millicent's Prosthesis; an Aeonian Bloom will appear in your world, and Gowry will disappear but leave a Flock's Canvas Talisman.
Talk to Moore
Miquella's Great Rune breaks
Talk to Moore to decide his fate

steps.location: Church of the Crusade or Enir-Ilim
steps.action: Defeat Moore
Talk to Thiollier
Talk to Moore to receive Black Syrup
Talk to 5 Forager Brood to receive Forager Brood Cookbook 1-3, 5, 6

steps.location: Church of the Crusade, Scadu Altus
steps.action: Use a Sunwarmth Stone on the Forager Brood Rest and return to receive Forager Brood Cookbook 4
Talk to Moore to receive Forager Brood Cookbook 7

Defeat both Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood. Then rest on the nearest Site of Grace. Leda will appear in front of Miquella's cocoon at Mohgywn Dynasty Mausoleum and urge to interact with it.

Talk with Roderika, receiving the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes, and give her the Chrysalids' Memento retrieved from Godrick's grafting grounds in Stormveil Castle to have her move to the Roundtable Hold. Otherwise, just entering Liurnia of the Lakes is enough to trigger this passage and, while the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes will be lost, the Golden Seed you'd have received at the Hold can instead be found in her spot at the shack.

Talk with Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing and exhaust his dialogues to have him move inside his study guarded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Talk with Hewg selecting **About Roderika**, then speak to her selecting **Tell her what the blacksmith said** and finally return to the smithing master selecting **About Roderika** -> **Would you watch over Roderika?** -> **It's what she wants**. Roderika becoming a Spirit Tuner under Hewg's wing is necessary to complete step #7.

Past the first two Stormhawks, Nepheli can be found in a small room on the path leading to the Secluded Cell Site of Grace. Exhaust her dialogue to unlock her summon sign outside the fog gate of Godrick the Grafted. *(Optional)* Summoning her will unlock alternate dialogue in the next step of her questline.

Nepheli will be standing just outside Gideon's study. Talk to her to receive the Arsenal Charm. If you defeated Godrick without speaking to her in the previous step, she will not give the Arsenal Charm.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Village of the Albinaurics)
steps.action: Nepheli can be found on the slope leading up to the village. Exhaust her dialogue to unlock her summon sign past the bridge leading to the Omenkiller Mini-Boss.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (The Four Belfries)
steps.action: Use an Imbued Sword Key (one is found in the chest near the Site of Grace) at the **Precipice of Anticipation**'s Sending Gate to return to the starting area of the game and, past the Grafted Scion, enter the previously closed door next to the Chapel of Anticipation to reach the rooftop where The Stormhawk King is found.

With the Omenkiller defeated (regardless of whether you summoned her), she will return to the Roundtable Hold, relocating at the bottom of the stairs near Hewg. Talk to her, then speak with Gideon selecting **Nepheli's despair** and return to Nepheli to exhaust her dialogues. At this point, you'll have the following options available: **Give Seluvis's Potion**: if you have initiated Ranni the Witch's questline at Caria Manor and talked with Preceptor Seluvis, you can administer this tonic to Nepheli, ending her questline prematurely, with Nepheli Loux Puppet becoming available for purchase from Pidia, Carian Servant. **Give The Stormhawk King**: this Key Item will allow her questline to enter its final stage, once exhausted all of her dialogues.

After defeating Morgott, the Omen King, return to the Godrick the Grafted Site of Grace and exhaust Gatekeeper Gostoc's dialogues, reloadig the area until he disappears from stomping on Godrick's corpse. Gostoc and Nepheli will now be found within the throne room of Stormveil Caste: exhaust her dialogues to receive Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone x1 and he too will now sell one for 20,000 Runes. While this also concludes Kenneth Haight's questline, without the need to have proceeded through any of the other steps in his questline in order to unlock this step, he is completely optional for Nepheli and Gostoc's questline.
*(Optional)* Nepheli's summon sign can be found outside the fog gate of Godfrey, First Elden Lord, alongside Shabriri's if the player has followed Hyetta and Yura's questlines.
*(Optional)* Istvan can be summoned to aid you against the two Demi-Human Chiefs and their small army.

Talk to Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress selecting **Join Volcano Manor** to receive the Drawing-Room Key that opens the doors to the eastern quarter of the manor, where the  is found. Upon collecting it, you'll be tasked with hunting down Istvan and the position of his invasion sign will be marked in red on the map. Once the Old Knight is defeated, awarding you with his Scale Set, return to Tanith to receive Magma Shot and collect the second  to progress her questline.

Pass through the golden fog into the boss room and loot the Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers from the treasure chest to trigger Patches to jump down from above. After reducing his health to 50%, he will stop attacking and grant the Grovel for Mercy gesture. He will now become available as a merchant after reloading the area. Continuing to attack him will cause him to become hostile again. If he gets your health low enough, he will grant the Extreme Repentance gesture. Using this will cause him to stop attacking again. *(Optional)* There will be another chest in his room after returning. Using this will trigger a trap which will teleport you to the Mistwood. It will not be possible to fast travel until you have rested at a Site of Grace. Patches will grant the Calm Down! gesture after returning to him.

Patches can be found near the Scenic Isle Site of Grace. He will discuss Rya and the Abductor Virgin below the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Clearing the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber and returning to Patches will unlock new dialogue, as well as the Calm Down! gesture if not received in the previous step.

From the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, go west past the siege tower and then north. Patches will advise you to follow a path of Glowstones leading to a ledge, which Patches will then kick you off.

Patches can be found in the entrance corridor after entering Tanith's service. After completing Tanith's first request, Patches will give you a request to kill Great-Horned Tragoth. Tragoth can be found in the Magma Wyrm Makar boss room in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Kill him and then return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue, then rest at a Site of Grace and speak to him again to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to Patches and exhaust his dialogue.

Patches can be found in the hallway leading to Elemer of the Briar. Talk to him to receive the Dancer's Castanets. Offer the Dancer's Castanets to Tanith in Rykard's boss room. She will refuse them, however they will be removed from your inventory.
Return to Murkwater Cave and enter the boss room. Open the chest to trigger another fight with Patches. Attack him once to make him stop attacking, and he will give the Patches' Crouch gesture.
Speak with Latenna the Albinauric and acquire Latenna the Albinauric (spirit ash).
Bring Latenna the Albinauric to the Apostate Derelict in the Consecrated Snowfield.

If Ranni the Witch has not been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player can find Pidia on the second floor of the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace. However, he can only be reached from the building's rooftop. To gain access to him, the player must travel to the Three Sisters and follow the clifftop above Caria Manor southwest. Once there, the player can descend several platforms in order to safely reach the Manor rooftop below. When first talking with Pidia, he will offer to sell you a number of rare items from his storeroom.

If Ranni the Witch has been given either the Fingerslayer Blade OR Seluvis' Amber Draught, the player will hear Pidia crying out in pain when approaching his location. Upon reaching him, the player will find Pidia lying dead, surrounded by the puppet soldiers he once maintained. The player can loot Pidia's Bell Bearing from his corpse, as well as one of two puppets depending upon certain conditions. If the player has already given Seluvis' Potion to Nepheli Loux, Pidia will drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet. If the player has not given Seluvis' Potion to Nepheli Loux, Pidia will drop Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet, instead.
Follow Ranni the Witch's questline and join her service in Ranni's Rise. Speak to the projections of Blaidd, Iji, and Seluvis, and then speak to Ranni once again.
Visit Seluvis's Rise, south of Ranni's Rise, and speak to Seluvis. Agree to his request to obtain Seluvis's Potion.

steps.location: Perform any one of the following to proceed with Seluvis's questline:
steps.action: Give Nepheli Loux the potion. In order to do this, you must have defeated the Omenkiller in the Village of the Albinaurics and Nepheli must be in the lower level of Roundtable Hold. You will obtain Nepheli Loux Puppet from Pidia, Carian Servant at the end of his questline. Give Dung Eater the potion. In order to do this, you must have obtained a Seedbed Curse, freed Dung Eater from his gaol, defeated his dark spirit in the Capital Outskirts, and made sure Dung Eater has returned to his gaol. You will be able to obtain Dung Eater Puppet from Seluvis after this. Talk to Gideon Ofnir and give him the potion.
Return to Seluvis and exhaust his dialogue, regardless of the option chosen in the previous step. His shop inventory will now be available.
Travel to the ruins north-east of Ranni's Rise and pass through the illusory floor. Go down the steps into the cellar and interact with the message saying "Seluvis' puppet. Do not touch."
Return to Seluvis and select the "About your chambers" dialogue option. You will now be able to buy puppets from Seluvis in return for Starlight Shards. Buy any one of these puppets to continue.
Speak to Seluvis again and select the "About the scheme" dialogue option.

Obtain the Amber Starlight from Altus Plateau. This can be found in a small grotto north-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, north of the giant staircase that leads to the Tree Sentinel boss fight.
Return to Seluvis and select the "Give Amber Starlight" dialogue option to obtain the Magic Scorpion Charm.
Reload the area and speak to Seluvis to obtain the Amber Draught.

You may attempt to give the Amber Draught to Ranni. Doing so will lock Ranni's questline, and it can only be resumed by seeking Absolution at the Church of Vows. Talking to her three times after trying to give her the draught will cause her to instantly kill you.
Seluvis will now be dead. His Bell bearing and armour set can be looted from his body, which can also be interacted with to access the puppet shop. Pidia will also die at this stage.
If Ranni is not given the Amber Draught, Seluvis will die in the same way after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.

After meeting Melina and obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle, use Torrent at least once. After that, rest on any Site of Grace. Then, fast travel to the  Church of Elleh Site of Grace and find Ranni (using the pseudonym "**Renna the Witch**") sitting on a broken wall. Exhaust her dialogue to receive the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes for free. If you miss this step, these items will be available for purchase at the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold— 200 runes for the Lone Wolf Ashes and  1,000 runes for the Spirit Calling Bell respectively.
Traverse Caria Manor in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes. Defeat the apparition of Royal Knight Loretta at the  Royal Moongazing Grounds, which unlocks the path to Three Sisters behind her.

Ranni can next be encountered on the top floor of her Rise in the Three Sisters. This stage varies depending on whether you have met her before, defeated Starscourge Radahn, or given Sorcerer Rogier the Black Knifeprint. Agree to become one of Ranni's vassals, and then head back down the tower to speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis. After speaking to all three, return to Ranni and speak to her again. After this point, if you return to Ranni, she will be sleeping and non-responsive. *(Optional)* Administer Preceptor Seluvis's Amber Draught to Ranni. She will awaken. Speak to her three times, and she will banish you from her sight. **WARNING:** This will permanently end Preceptor Seluvis and Pidia, Carian Servant's quests. **WARNING:** Ranni's questline will no longer progress; however, this can be undone by using Celestial Dew to receive absolution at the Church of Vows.
Defeat Starscourge Radahn to resume the movement of the stars.

Nokron can only be accessed via the *Starfall Crater* in east Limgrave after defeating Starscourge Radahn. Proceed through the area to obtain the Fingerslayer Blade, which is in a chest northeast of the  Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace.

Travel to Ranni's Rise and deliver the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required to progress Fia, Deathbed Companion's questline. However, it is *not* necessary to complete Ranni's quest. **WARNING:** This will permanently end Preceptor Seluvis and Pidia, Carian Servant's quest. Travel to Renna's Rise, which unseals after Ranni departs with the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the Sending Gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the  Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.

*(Optional)* Ranni will also have dialogue at the  Nokstella, Eternal City and  Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline. Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the  Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key.
Defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Unlock the chest behind Rennala and obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Ride the Transportation Coffin at the Grand Cloister. Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void and then travel up the lift. However, this lift remains locked until the player obtains the Dark Moon Ring.

Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again, and she will disappear, bequeathing the Dark Moon Greatsword.

After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign beside  Fractured Marika. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending. **WARNING:** Ranni's summon sign will not appear if the player has met with the Three Fingers. This can be undone by defeating both Malenia, Goddess of Rot and Dragonlord Placidusax, and using Miquella's Needle in the latter's boss arena at Crumbling Farum Azula.
First conversion with Guilbert south of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave.
Defeat Crucible Knight Floh. *(Optional)* Summon **Mercenary Swordsman** from his gold summon sign.
Second conversation with Guilbert, which changes based on choices.

Guilbert will stand in the throne room. There is no direct information about what he would do here. *(Optional?)* Receive a nameless Key Item from Guilbert? Give it to Roundtable Knight Vyke to receive Neutralizing Boluses and enable his summon sign for Godrick the Grafted. Defeat Godrick the Grafted. *(Optional)* Summon **Guilbert** from his gold summon sign and defeat Godrick the Grafted.

After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan under Tanith's request, retrieve the second Letter from Volcano Manor to unlock Rileigh's invasion sign in Altus Plateau. With Istvan dead, you can also talk to Patches the Untethered to receive Letter to Patches, tasking you with killing Great Horned Tragoth in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Once Rileigh is disposed of, return to Tanith to receive the Serpentbone Blade: the Red Letter will now appear, targetting Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood in the Mountaintops of the Giants. You can also visit Recusant Bernhal to receive the Letter to Bernahl, offering you to join him in his hunt against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Roderika can be found in Stormhill Shack in Stormhill, provided you have not defeated Godrick the Grafted or touched a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. Exhaust her dialogue to obtain both the "Sitting Sideways" Gesture and Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.
In an adjoining courtyard to the large hall containing a Grafted Scion in Stormveil Castle, pick up the Chrysalids' Memento.
Deliver the Crysalids' Memento to Roderika in Stormhill Shack and exhaust her dialogue to get her to move to Roundtable Hold.

Roderika can be found by the fireplace in the central room. Talk to her to obtain a Golden Seed once she arrives. **Note**: if you defeated Godrick or rest at a Site of Grace in Liurnia without speaking to Roderika in Stormhill Shack, she will move to Roundtable Hold on her own, and will leave the Golden Seed on the ground in the shack.
Speak to Roderika, and then speak to Smithing Master Hewg and select "About Roderika".
Return to Roderika and speak to her to tell her what Hewg said.
Return to Hewg and select "About Roderika" again, followed by "Would you watch over Roderika?" and finally "It's what she wants".
Reload the area and Roderika will be sitting opposite Hewg. It is now possible to upgrade Spirit Ashes by speaking to her.
Upgrade a Spirit Ash to at least +4 and talk to her to receive the "Curtsy" Gesture.

After burning the Erdtree, return to the Roundtable Hold, speak to Hewg, and select "Let's talk a while". You may then select the dialogue option "Why are you still making weapons?" After talking to Roderika and selecting "About Hewg", return to Hewg and select "What happened to her?"
After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, speak to Hewg and select "About yourself", and then speak to Roderika.

Rya can be found in a folly north of the Laskyar Ruins. Speak to her and exhaust her dialogue, then travel to Boilprawn Shack and purchase Rya's Necklace from Blackguard Big Boggart. Return to Rya and hand over the necklace to receive an Invitation to Volcano Manor. It is not possible to kill her in this location, as she is protected by a barrier.

If the previous step was completed, Rya will be waiting at Lux Ruins in Altus Plateau. Speak to her and she will offer to transport you to Volcano Manor. It is not possible to kill her in this location, as she is protected by a barrier.

Rya can now be found in the Volcano Manor drawing room after joining the Recusants. After defeating Old Knight Istvan and receiving the reward from Tanith, talk to Rya in the drawing room, then reload the area and enter the previously locked room across the corridor from the drawing room to find Rya in serpent form. Exhaust her dialogue.

After defeating Rileigh the Idle and receiving the reward from Tanith, speak to Rya in the same room as the previous step. Go into the room next to this and pass through the illusory wall at the back, then follow the path to the prison Town Church Site of Grace. Rest at the Site of Grace, then return to Rya and speak to her once again.
After defeating the Godskin Noble boss in Volcano Manor, obtain the Serpent's Amnion and give it to Rya. *(Optional)* Speak to Tanith to obtain the Tonic of Forgetfulness.

Rya can now be found in a small room above the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, past an Iron Virgin. You now have three options to resolve this questline. If you received the Tonic of Forgetfulness, you may offer it to her, causing her to fall asleep. After killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, return to the Volcano Manor drawing room and speak to her. Reload the area and return to where she was to obtain Daedicar's Woe. If you choose to kill her, you will obtain Daedicar's Woe. If you refuse to kill her and do not give her the Tonic of Forgetfulness, return to where she was after defeating Rykard to obtain Daesicar's Woe and Zorayas's Letter.

Shabriri can be found by the  Zamor Ruins Site of Grace near the beginning of the Mountaintops of the Giants area. Exhaust his dialogue to unlock new dialogue from Melina when resting at a Site of Grace.

Travel to the Frenzied Flame Proscription through the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and Cathedral of the Forsaken. Remove all of your armor and interact with the door on the lowest floor for a cutscene in which the Three Fingers embrace you. This can be done regardless of whether you have met Shabriri already. Doing so will cause Shabriri to disappear from his previous location.
Shabriri will be available as a cooperator to assist with the fight against Godfrey, First Elden Lord at the Elden Throne if the player has not used Miquella's Needle.
Three-Path Cross (Gravesite Plain)
Specimen Storehouse
Enir-Ilim
*(Optional)* If you visit Roundtable Hold before defeating a shardbearer, Gideon can be found in the central chamber of Roundtable Hold. After exhausting his dialogue he will move to his study.

After defeating a shardbearer and speaking to Finger Reader Enia, Gideon will welcome you as a member of Roundtable Hold, and will offer you information on Godrick the Grafted, Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, Starscourge Radahn, Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, and Morgott, the Omen King. He can also discuss Nepheli Loux if you have spoken to her.

*(Optional)* If you obtain either half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, Ensha will ambush you the next time you return to Roundtable Hold. After defeating him, speak to Gideon to learn the location of the other half. *(Optional)* If you have obtained Seluvis's Potion, you may give it to Gideon to dispose of it. This will remove it from your inventory, preventing you from obtaining Nepheli Loux Puppet or Dung Eater Puppet.
Resting at any Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital will cause Gideon to receive new dialogue about the unlocated Demigods.

Gideon will now offer rewards in exchange for meeting certain requirements: Black Flame's Protection: activate a Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree. Lord's Divine Fortification: defeat Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Fevor's Cookbook 3: activate a Site of Grace in Mohgwyn Palace. Law of Causality: defeat Mohg, Lord of Blood.

Gideon will be present in the Erdtree Sanctuary as a boss encounter after you have defeated Maliketh, the Black Blade. Any previous parts of his questline will now be locked, however the rewards from the previous step can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks.
Speak to Hewg

steps.location: Once Roderika arrives at the Roundtable Hold, speak to Hewg and select the **"About Roderika"** dialogue option.
steps.action: Return to Roderika and tell her what Hewg said. Return to Hewg and select **"About Roderika"** again, followed by **"Would you watch over Roderika?"** and finally **"It's what she wants"**. Reload the area. Roderika moves, seated across from Hewg, now offers spirit tuning services.
Upon reaching the Forge of the Giants, return and talk for advice.

steps.location: After burning the Erdtree, return to the Roundtable Hold and select **"Let's talk a while"**. You may then select the dialogue option **"Why are you still making weapons?"**
steps.action: After talking to Roderika and selecting **"About Hewg"**, return to Hewg and select **"What happened to her?"**
After defeating the Godskin Duo, return to Roundtable Hold and speak to Hewg and select **"About the god-slaying weapon"**.
After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, return to Hewg and select **"About yourself"**.

*(Optional)* Exhaust his dialogue in Stormveil Castle encounter. He can be found in the chapel past the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. Witness his bloodstain after killing the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the lower section of Stormveil Castle. Doing so before defeating Godrick will cause him to disappear from Stormveil, regardless of whether you have done step 1.
Meet him at Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick. Tell him that you have defeated Godrick and then ask about the corpse below Stormveil. Speak to Fia to learn about the Black Knifeprint.
Obtain the Black Knifeprint from the wounded Black Knife Assassin in Black Knife Catacombs in Liurnia.
Give Rogier the Black Knifeprint. *(Optional)* Ask Fia about Rogier. Reload the area and speak to Rogier. He will ask you to investigate Ranni.
Head to Ranni's Rise and speak to Ranni. She will be dismissive and ask you to leave.
Return to Roundtable Hold and tell Rogier about Ranni. He will ask that you enter her service to further the investigation.
Return to Ranni's Rise and agree to serve Ranni.

Return to Roundtable Hold and speak to Rogier. He will tell you that his condition is worsening. Reload the area and Rogier will be unresponsive. Any unseen dialogue options will be locked and his shop will be unavailable. Reload the area again and Rogier will be dead, leaving behind his gear, bell bearing and a letter.
Thops can be found at the Church of Irith in Liurnia of the Lakes. Speak to him and agree to donate 10 Runes to unlock his shop.

After obtaining the Academy Glintstone Key from within the Academy of Raya Lucaria, return to Thops and hand it to him in order to receive the "Erudition" Gesture. Note that he will not accept the Academy Glintstone Key found near Glintstone Dragon Smarag in north-western Liurnia, as this one is required for you to gain entry to the Academy.

Thops's corpse can be found sitting at a desk outside the room containing the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace. Loot his body to obtain Thops's Barrier, an Academy Glintstone Staff, and Thops's Bell Bearing. Ash of War: Thops's Barrier can now be obtained from a scarab at the Church of Irith.

Sellen can be found in the cellar of Waypoint Ruins after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head. Talk to Sellen and then select "I wish to learn glintstone sorceries" to receive the "Nod in Thought" Gesture, and to unlock her sorcery shop. *(Optional)* If the Radahn Festival has not commenced, Sellen will have dialogue about it if you have Seluvis's Introduction in your inventory. This is obtained by progressing Blaidd the Half-Wolf's questline and speaking to Seluvis about Nokron prior to initiating the Festival.

Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur, located beyond the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir, to obtain Comet Azur. Return to Sellen and select the "Show Azur's Sorcery" dialogue option. After listening to this dialogue, select the "Tell me your story" option, and then select "Let us journey together". Next, select "I have a favor to ask" to obtain the Sellian Sealbreaker. The Sellian Sealbreaker can be used to open a sealed tunnel in Sellia Hideaway, behind which is Primeval Sorcerer Lusat. Interact with him to receive Stars of Ruin. It is now possible to select the "Lusat's location" dialogue option when talking to Sellen, which will reward you with a Starlight Shards. This option can be avoided until later in the questline.

After Starscourge Radahn has been defeated, talk to Sellen to learn that her true body is in Witchbane Ruins. Travel there and speak to the shackled Sellen to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone. Reload the area and return to find Castellan Jerren. In order for him to appear, you must have spoken to him in Redmane Castle after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

Travel to the Three Sisters and go to the ruined structure north-east of Ranni's Rise. Roll or attack the ground to reveal a hidden staircase leading to a basement full of immobile puppets. Pass through the illusory wall on the far end of the room to find a puppet duplicate of Sellen. Interact with the puppet to insert Sellen's Primal Glintstone, resurrecting Sellen in her new body.

There will now be two summon signs outside the door to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library; one red and one gold. To progress Sellen's questline, select the gold summon sign. You will be summoned as a co-operator to assist Sellen in defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren. Defeat Jerren to receive the Eccentric's Set. This step can only be completed if Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been defeated.

After defeating Jerren, Sellen can be found where Rennala is usually based. Speak to her to receive the Glintstone Kris. If you have not done so already, find Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway and speak to Sellen to select "Lusat's location" and receive Starlight Shards. It is also possible to obtain Azur and Lusat's armour sets by returning to their respective locations at this point.

Reload the area after telling Sellen about Lusat. Sellen, now in the form of a Graven Mass, can be found  to the side of the room. The Witch's Glintstone Crown can be obtained here. It is still possible to purchase sorceries from her and to offer her scrolls.
Approach the Shadow Keep until Miquella's Great Rune breaks, dispelling his seal on the Stone Coffin Fissure.

Defeat Putrescent Knight Imbibe St. Trina's nectar and die Imbibe her nectar and die Imbibe her nectar and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Imbibe her nectar, hear her voice, and die Speak with Thiollier
Defeat Miquella the Kind and Radahn, Consort of Miquella
Collect St. Trina's Blossom
Go into the corridor to the right of Tanith and open the first door on the left. Pick up the Letter from Volcano Manor on the table as well as the Recusant Finger.
Travel to the entrance to the colosseum in Stormhill and interact with the invasion sign to fight Old Knight Istvan. After defeating him, report back to Tanith to obtain Magma Shot.

Go back to the drawing room and pick up the Letter from Volcano Manor. Travel to Altus Plateau and find an invasion sign at the bottom of the gorge leading to Shaded Castle. Interact with the sign to fight Rileigh the Idle. After defeating him, talk to Tanith to obtain the Serpentbone Blade.

*(Optional)* If you have advanced Rya's questline and met her in serpent form, and rested at a Site of Grace in the main dungeon area of Volcano Manor, speak to Tanith to obtain the Tonic of Forgetfulness. This step will be locked if you kill Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood, before giving Rya the Serpent's Amnion.

Pick up the Red Letter from the drawing room, and travel to the Shack of the Lofty in the Mountaintops of the Giants. Interact with the invasion sign to fight Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood. Report back to Tanith to obtain the Taker's Cameo.
Tanith will now offer to send you directly to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, bypassing the rest of the Volcano Manor. Defeat Rykard and return to Tanith and exhaust her dialogue.
Travel to the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace to find Tanith eating the remains of Rykard.

*(Optional)* After obtaining the Dancer's Castanets from Patches in Shaded Castle, offer them to Tanith. There is no reward for doing so, however the Dancer's Castanets will be removed from your inventory.

*(Optional)* Attacking Tanith will cause her to die in a single hit. You will then be invaded by Tanith's Knight. Defeating the knight will reward you with Aspects of the Crucible: Breath and the Consort's Set.
Goldmask can be found at the end of the broken bridge, facing the Erdtree. Interact with him to progress.
Speak to Corhyn to reveal Goldmask's location.
Return to the bridge and exhaust Corhyn's dialogue.

Goldmask and Corhyn can be found near the colosseum. Corhyn will express frustration at Goldmask's current obsession with Radagon. After using Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue past the lift near Erdtree Sanctuary, talk to Goldmask to reveal Radagon's secret and then talk to Corhyn.
Goldmask and Corhyn will move to the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins.

After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, Goldmask's corpse can be found on a slope near the colosseum. Loot his corpse to receive the Mending Rune of Perfect Order, which will unlock the option to complete the Age of Order ending. After reloading the area, return to Goldmask's corpse to retrieve Goldmask's Rags, Gold Bracelets, and Gold Waistwrap.

Speak with Moore outside Belurat, Tower Settlement. Find and speak with Thiollier at the  Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace. Speak with Moore again and he will give you Black Syrup for Thiollier. Find Thiollier again and he will give you Thiollier's Concoction. After all this is done, approach the Shadow Keep, and you will get an ominous message on the screen. Find Thiollier once more, and after exhausting his dialogue, reload the area, and he'll state he is heading south.

Make your way to the southernmost point of the Cerulean Coast, where you'll find a pit. When facing south towards the pit, turn to the right; there are steps leading into it. Follow the given path, and you'll come across the Stone Coffin Fissure. Beat the Putrescent Knight, a boss found at the end of this Legacy Dungeon, and in the corner of the arena, you'll find both the  Garden of Deep Purple Site of Grace and Thiollier, in front of St. Trina. Exhaust Thiollier's Dialogue and then reset the area using the nearby Grace. Return and Thiollier will have new dialogue, exhaust it again, and then imbibe St. Trina's nectar, repeating this step (6 times) until St. Trina speaks to you. Once that is complete, pass on St. Trina's words to Thiollier, who will be reluctant to believe these words, and choose to try passing on St. Trina's words again and exhaust his dialogue. After this, return to the Grace. Here you will immediately be invaded by Thiollier, so defeat him and enter St. Trina's garden. Speak to Thiollier, then imbibe St. Trina's nectar again until she speaks. Here you can tell Thiollier of what she has said and exhaust his dialogue.
Thiollier will now be available to summon for the two final fights of the *Shadow of The Erdtree*'s story, where his quest finishes.

After joining the Volcano Manor and eliminating Old Knight Istvan and Rileigh the Idle under Tanith's request, talk to Recusant Bernahl in the eastern quarter of the manor to receive Letter to Bernhal, unlocking Vargram's invasion sign in Leyndell. Once the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm are defeated, awarding you with the Raging Wolf Set, return to Bernhal to receive Gelmir's Fury.
Reload the area three times. Speak with Volcano Manor Apparition to gain a clue about the Serpent-Hunter

steps.action: If Blaidd’s quest is active, choose “Blaidd sent me” to unlock a new shop item.

steps.location: After entering Ranni’s service, speak to his projection at Ranni's Rise.
steps.action: Optional: Ask about Blaidd or Jerren after progressing Ranni’s questline.
After Radahn’s defeat, revisit Iji for information about Nokron.
After giving Ranni the Dark Moon Ring, defeat Blaidd and return to Iji.
Reload the area to find Iji slain. Collect his helm and bell bearing.

*(Optional)* Talk to Varré next to The First Step Site of Grace. *(Optional)* After visiting the Roundtable Hold, return to Varré and exhaust his dialogue. *(Optional)* After obtaining a Great Rune, return to Varré and exhaust his dialogue. *(Optional)* After talking to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold, read the message he leaves behind to receive the "Bravo!" Gesture.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)
steps.action: As he moves at the entrance of the Rose Church after speaking with Enia, talk to him, selecting **They didn't seem right**, and exhaust his dialogues to receive Festering Bloody Finger x5.

steps.location: Altus Plateau (Road of Iniquity Side Path)
steps.action: Interact with the invasion sign of Magnus the Beast Claw, found at the Writheblood Ruins south-west of the Site of Grace, and either defeat him or simply invade him three times. Invading actual players with the Festering Bloody Fingers three times is also enough to progress Varré's questline.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)
steps.action: Return to Varré to receive the Lord of Blood's Favor, which needs to be coated in a maiden's blood. The followings options are available: The corpse of your Finger Maiden in the Chapel of Anticipation, which requires using an Imbued Sword Key at the Four Bellfries of Liurnia. Vyke's Finger Maiden in the Church of Inhibition of Liurnia. Killing Irina of Morne or, if already deceased, Lightseeker Hyetta at any of their locations.

steps.location: Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake)
steps.action: Return to Varré to receive the Bloody Finger, then talk to him again to receive the Pureblood Knight's Medal.

Reaching Mohgwyn Palace either through the Pureblood Knight's Medal or the Waygate in Consacrated Snowfield, interact with Varré's invasion sign in the hallway right before Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. Once defeated, he'll drop Festering Bloody Finger x6, Rune Arc x1 and Furlcalling Finger Remedy x1. Talk to him near where his invasion sign was and, exhausting his dialogues, he'll die dropping Varré's Bouquet.
